articles.headline: South Africa's Thapelo Maseko joins Copenhagen from Mamelodi Sundowns
articles.description: South Africa winger Thapelo Maseko has sealed his move to Copenhagen from Mamelodi Sundowns on a four-year contract, the club announced on Tuesday.

images.name: Thapelo Maseko [1104x621]
images.caption: South Africa winger Thapelo Maseko poses at FC Kovenhavn (Copenhagen) after his move to the Danish side from Mamelodi Sundowns.

articles.headline: Izzo exits Melbourne Victory, Iredale joins AaB, Rojas returns to Phoenix
